sentences.en: I've always wanted to visit Stonehenge and see it for myself.
sentences.zh: 我一直想去实地看看巨石阵。

sentences.en: Stonehenge was built thousands of years ago, but no one knows why.
sentences.zh: 巨石阵是在几千年前建造的，但没人知道原因是什么。

sentences.en: Tourists from all over the world come to see Stonehenge every year.
sentences.zh: 每年世界各地都有游客来参观巨石阵。
